Name: Mystic Rift
Author: ChickenCoder
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Mystic Rift adds a craftable teleportation altar to your farm. Throw in resources like stone, gems, or rare materials to open a rift to a random location. A return portal appears at your destination, but it only lasts for a limited time!

Where will you end up? The beach? The desert? The witch's swamp? It's a gamble every time!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io)
2. Download and extract into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. Launch via SMAPI
4. Reach Farming Level 4 to unlock the recipe
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- Craftable Mystic Rift altar (Farming Level 4)
- Crafting cost: 50 Stone, 30 Wood, 5 Iridium Ore (configurable)
- Throw resources to activate:
  • Common items (stone, wood, fiber) → Easy locations (Forest, Town, Beach, Mountain)
  • Gems (amethyst, topaz, emerald, ruby, diamond) → Medium locations (Secret Woods, Mines, Quarry)
  • Rare items (iridium ore, prismatic shard) → Hard locations (Desert, Witch Swamp, Bug Land)
- Temporary return portal at destination (120 minutes, configurable)
- Dark Shrine sprite from vanilla game
- Configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Required:
- SMAPI 4.0.0+

Optional:
- Generic Mod Config Menu (for settings)
